footer.v: 0 - Theo thời gian, 1 - Phân bổ 2 lần

command.text: declare @size int = col_length('dmccdc', 'ma_dc'), @size2 int = col_length('dmccdc', 'ten_dc')/2 select 'this.getItem(''ma_cc'').maxLength = ' + rtrim(@size) + ';this.getItem(''ten_cc'').maxLength = ' + rtrim(@size2) as message return

declare @baseCurrency&Controller; varchar(32), @method&Controller; char(1) select @method&Controller; = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_cc_kh' select @baseCurrency&Controller; = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0'
select 'this._baseCurrency&Controller;=''' + @baseCurrency&Controller; + ''';this.$_method&Controller; = ' + @method&Controller; + ';active$Form&Controller;(this);onChange&Controller;$Currency(this);' as message return

action.text: if exists(select 1 from dmttndccdc where ma_pl_cc = @ma_pl_cc and status = '1') begin select a.kieu_pb, a.so_ky_pb, rtrim(a.ma_phi), rtrim(a.loai_dc), b.ten_loai%l, rtrim(a.ma_ld_tg), c.ten_tg_ts%l, rtrim(a.tk_dc), isnull(d.ten_tk%l, '') as ten_tk_dc, rtrim(a.tk_pb), isnull(e.ten_tk%l, '') as ten_tk_pb from dmttndccdc a with(nolock) left join dmplcc b with(nolock) on a.loai_dc = b.ma_loai left join dmtgcc c with(nolock) on a.ma_ld_tg = c.ma_tg_ts left join dmtk d with(nolock) on a.tk_dc = d.tk and d.loai_tk = 1 left join dmtk e with(nolock) on a.tk_pb = e.tk and e.loai_tk = 1 where a.ma_pl_cc = @ma_pl_cc and a.status = '1' return end
